description: Analyse raw email headers (the full source from Show original or View message source) without any network call: lists every Received hop in delivery order with host, IP, time and delay between hops; extracts From, Reply-To, Return-Path, Subject, Date, Message-ID and mailer; reads SPF, DKIM and DMARC results from Authentication-Results, ARC-Authentication-Results and Received-SPF with the domain each was checked for; and flags warning signs such as Reply-To on a different domain, SPF or DMARC failure, no DKIM, a display name that pretends to be an address or brand, a first hop from a home connection, clock skew and a mismatched Message-ID domain. Returns a verdict (consistent, caution or suspicious). It does not query DNS, so it reports what the receiving servers recorded rather than re-checking it. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/email-header-analyser/
